updates.note: Management states they are confident of exceeding the full year FY26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows.
updates.quote: We are confident of exceeding our full year FY '26 guidance of 10% growth in group order inflows for the current year.

updates.note: Management maintains full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.
updates.quote: Accordingly, we maintain our full year revenue growth guidance at 15%.

updates.note: Management states guidance for working capital remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.
updates.quote: On Working Capital, our guidance for working capital for FY '26 remains unchanged at around 12% by March 2026.

updates.note: Management reaffirms full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5% for P&M business.
updates.quote: With the execution momentum expected to pick up in H2, we are reasonably confident to achieve our full year EBITDA margin target of 8.5%.
